subject: music
source_note: Structure follows the IB Diploma Music guide (first assessment 2022): four areas of inquiry explored through exploring, experimenting and presenting, in the roles of researcher, creator and performer. HL adds 'The contemporary music-maker', a real-life project combining all three roles. Component names are guide-accurate; connections, sequence and prerequisites are expert-authored teaching relationships (the IB does not publish these).
